title: Moving Standard Deviation
scenario: Calculate a 7-day trailing standard deviation of asset prices.
tableSchema: prices (asset_id INT, trade_date DATE, price NUMERIC)
hint: Use the ROWS BETWEEN frame clause.
correctQuery: SELECT asset_id, trade_date, STDDEV_SAMP(price) OVER(PARTITION BY asset_id ORDER BY trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS volatility FROM prices;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE prices (asset_id INT, trade_date DATE, price NUMERIC);
